import argparse,gc,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,resource,statistics,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path('tools').resolve()))
import numpy as np
import soundfile,torch,transformers
import validate_mini_bs_roformer as v
from reference_backends.mini_bs_roformer import _load,_load_published
base=pathlib.Path('${VALIDATION_WORKDIR}');a=base/'artifacts';out=a/'final-shared-cpu-12s-recovery.json'
stage_path=a/'final-shared-cpu-8s/validation.json';stage=json.loads(stage_path.read_text())
prior_path=a/'final-shared-cpu-12s.json';prior=json.loads(prior_path.read_text());log_path=a/'final-shared-cpu-12s.log'
assert stage['acceptance'] and stage['genuine_crispembed_profile']
assert v.sha256(stage_path)==prior['stage_and_8s_receipt_sha256']
library=base/'build/src/libcrispasr.so';assert v.sha256(library)==prior['library_sha256']=='f862d6bd1079bb787695f44d0c5fad281488bb4c6f391bfe09b3e80e4e60608d'
models={p:a/f'mini-bs-roformer-{p}.gguf' for p in ('f16','q8_0','q4_k')}
assert {p:v.sha256(path) for p,path in models.items()}==prior['expected_model_sha256']
assert {p:v.sha256(pathlib.Path(p)) for p in prior['source_sha256']}==prior['source_sha256']
retained={p:[] for p in models}
for line in log_path.read_text().splitlines():
 m=re.fullmatch(r'(f16|q8_0|q4_k): pair ([123])/3 native=([0-9.]+) ms python=([0-9.]+) ms quality=(PASS|FAIL)',line)
 if m:
  retained[m[1]].append({'iteration':int(m[2])-1,'native_ms':float(m[3]),'python_ms':float(m[4]),'native_vs_f32_all_stems_pass':m[5]=='PASS','provenance':'reconstructed from original exact-runner stdout; times rounded to 0.001 ms','numeric_stem_details':None,'timed_python_vs_f32_reference':None,'native_vs_timed_python':None})
assert [len(retained[p]) for p in models]==[3,3,1]
receipt={'acceptance':False,'task_acceptance':False,'status':'recovery-running','scope':'Finish only two unfinished Q4 pairs after exit137; retain completed F16/Q8 and Q4 pair1 timings without repetition or invented metrics','stage_and_8s_receipt_sha256':v.sha256(stage_path),'interrupted_receipt_sha256':v.sha256(prior_path),'interrupted_log_sha256':v.sha256(log_path),'original_runner_sha256':prior['runner_sha256'],'recovery_runner_sha256':v.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__)),'current_validator_sha256':v.sha256(pathlib.Path('tools/validate_mini_bs_roformer.py')),'source_sha256':prior['source_sha256'],'model_sha256':prior['expected_model_sha256'],'runtime':v.runtime_provenance(library),'retained_stdout_pairs':retained,'new_q4_pairs':[],'interruption':{'exit_code':137,'memory_limit_bytes':int(pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max').read_text()),'post_failure_memory_events':pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events').read_text(),'cleanup_manifest_sha256':v.sha256(a/'development-input-cleanup.json')},'timing_protocol':{'threads':2,'mode':'separate','python_dtype':'bfloat16','python_batch_size':4,'repetitions_per_precision':3,'original_session_warmups_per_precision':1,'recovery_session_warmups':1,'resumed_iterations':[1,2],'timing_boundary':'warm inference including result allocation/copy, excluding loading and audio read','completed_pair_timings_repeated':False}}
def checkpoint():
 temporary=out.with_name(out.name+'.tmp');temporary.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n');os.replace(temporary,out)
checkpoint()
audio,rate=soundfile.read(a/'music-12s.wav',dtype='float32',always_2d=True);audio=np.ascontiguousarray(audio)
assert rate==44100 and audio.shape==(529200,2) and np.isfinite(audio).all()
assert v.sha256(a/'music-12s.wav')==prior['audio_sha256']
receipt['input_pcm_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(audio.tobytes()).hexdigest();receipt['audio_sha256']=prior['audio_sha256']
torch.set_num_threads(2);waveform=torch.from_numpy(audio.T.copy());model_dir=pathlib.Path('${WORKSPACE}/blueprint_audit')
blueprint=_load(model_dir,device='cpu',dtype='float32')
def original():
 with torch.inference_mode():return blueprint.separate(waveform,batch_size=4,verbose=False).float().cpu().numpy().copy()

# Run after the captured recovery script creates the two original waveform arrays.
import hashlib, json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import soundfile
workspace = Path(os.environ["WORKSPACE"])
workdir = Path(os.environ["VALIDATION_WORKDIR"])
sys.path.insert(0, str(workspace / "CrispASR/tools"))
import validate_mini_bs_roformer as v
a = workdir / "artifacts"
r = json.loads((a / "final-shared-cpu-12s-recovery.json").read_text())
reference = np.load(a / "recovery-12s-f32-oracle.npy", allow_pickle=False)
bf16 = np.load(a / "recovery-12s-published-bf16.npy", allow_pickle=False)
assert hashlib.sha256(reference.tobytes()).hexdigest() == r["quality_reference_sha256"]
assert hashlib.sha256(bf16.tobytes()).hexdigest() == r["published_bf16_reference_sha256"]
audio, rate = soundfile.read(a / "music-12s.wav", dtype="float32", always_2d=True)
audio = np.ascontiguousarray(audio)
assert rate == 44100 and audio.shape == (529200, 2)
assert hashlib.sha256(audio.tobytes()).hexdigest() == r["input_pcm_sha256"]
library = workdir / "build/src/libcrispasr.so"
assert v.sha256(library) == r["runtime"]["library_sha256"]
for precision in ("f16", "q8_0"):
    model = a / f"mini-bs-roformer-{precision}.gguf"
    assert v.sha256(model) == r["model_sha256"][precision]
    native = v.NativeModel(library, model, 2, "cpu", "separate")
    try:
        actual = native.run(audio)
        print(precision, json.dumps({"native_vs_f32": v.waveform_metrics(actual, reference, v.THRESHOLDS[precision]), "native_vs_published_bf16": v.waveform_metrics(actual, bf16, v.THRESHOLDS[precision])}))
    finally:
        native.close()
assert hashlib.sha256(audio.tobytes()).hexdigest() == r["input_pcm_sha256"]
